name: Spaceship 1a403313 on 3.3.3.4.4
description: A period-5 spaceship on the elongated triangular tiling 3.3.3.4.4 (touching neighbours), 4 to 5 cells, moving one lattice step every 5 generations (c/5). It runs the same way in the 131,072 rules from B3/S2 to B3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12/S0,2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Its live cells evolve the same way on k3-013 and k3-019, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts, and on k2-003, k2-004, k3-010, k3-016, k3-051 and k3-052. The range of rules depends on the tiling: 131,072 rules on 3.3.3.4.4, k3-013, k3-019, k3-051 and k3-052; 8,192 rules on k2-003, k2-004, k3-010 and k3-016. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-019 (seen 229 times); it was catalogued a second time as cf8efa2e, found on k3-019 (seen 177 times). Flagged as most likely already known: small (4 to 5 cells), common (seen 406 times) and wide-range (131,072 rules) on an Archimedean tiling. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
